answer: Desert wildlife census attestation ties each identity to a census route across a dune field. On signup, the applicant files a field-biology certificate earned by exam and a supervised survey season, checked with the conservation registry, and one certificate backs one route. Each epoch the surveyor logs one banded raven along the route, through a prism spotting scope. Forging 100 identities needs 100 certificates at $370 each, $37,000 in total.
